Tom (Marketing): Heads-up: BlueCedar case study draft is ready from the interview. We need: a short pull quote, signed publish permission (embargo until 2026-05-20), logo release, translation for FR/DE, and webinar coordination. Can we lock this week?
Leah (AE): I can request the signed permission and logo today. Will ask them to confirm recording + distribution rights for the webinar.
Rina (CS): Raw quote from transcript: 
```
\"Redwood cut our per-token spend by 48% and halved tail latency in peak workloads.\"
```
Leah (AE): BlueCedar will probably push back on exact percentages. They usually prefer qualitative language.
Priya (Legal): FYI any numeric claim needs explicit written approval. Also check that the quote contains no customer PII or contract references. If they want numbers we need a short attestation.
Tom (Marketing): Okay, propose we offer two options to them: one with numbers for their approval, and one non-numeric for quick publish. Suggest non-numeric: 
"Redwood helped us reduce costs and improve response times during peak traffic."
Carlos (Product): That reads fine. For the webinar, we want a 7-min case highlight + panel. Can BlueCedar provide a speaker and a 1-paragraph bio?
Leah (AE): I'll ask Amanda (BlueCedar contact). Also confirming they want leads routed to their AE queue. If yes, we should confirm lead filtering (MQL threshold / region) and a webhook endpoint.
Maya (Design): Once we have final quote + SVG logo + hero photo, I can make the case page hero and social cards. For FR/DE translations, who owns copy? We can send copy to vendor but need budget sign-off.
Tom (Marketing): We'll use internal localization vendor — small fee. Budget approved by marketing ops. Priority: US launch with translated pages by end of month.
Rina (CS): Another consent question: BlueCedar asked to embargo publication until May 20 to coincide with their product announcement. We'll mark the case as embargoed.
Priya (Legal): Good. Add an embargo clause in their permission email: e.g., "Permission to publish on or after 2026-05-20, and permit recording distribution." Save that email to the legal folder.
deploy-bot: Note added: marketing/case-studies/bluecedar -> embargo:2026-05-20 by Tom.
Leah (AE): BlueCedar replied: they approve qualitative quote, will not sign off on percentage without internal review, logo ok, speaker Amanda confirmed, and they want only MQL>=60 leads routed to their webhook. They will send signed permission by EOD.
Carlos (Product): For lead routing, we can create a tag `partner:bluecedar` and only send leads with `mql_score>=60`. Send me the webhook URL and sample payload.
Leah (AE): Forwarded their webhook endpoint to Sales Ops. Also asked for the speaker bio (they'll send).
Maya (Design): Noted. We'll design social card using the short quote. Could we get a punchy one-liner? Tom, can you draft social copy?
Tom (Marketing): Draft social line: "How BlueCedar cut inference cost and sped up app responses with Redwood 12 Join our webinar May 20." (will refine — keep non-numeric).
Rina (CS): Reminder: transcript contains a customer email in one snippet; I redacted it in the draft. Rechecked for PII.
Priya (Legal): Confirmed redaction ok. Once signed permission arrives, I need the final quote pasted into this thread and the attached signed email.
Leah (AE): Signed permission just came in. Uploading now. It includes: permission to publish on/after 2026-05-20, logo usage (svg/png), recording distribution ok, and explicit approval of the non-numeric quote. Forwarded to @Priya and @Maya.
Maya (Design): Got the files. I'll push first-pass assets by Wed EOD.
Tom (Marketing): Great. Action items: Leah get bio + confirm lead webhook mapping (Mon), Maya posts assets Wed, Carlos sets up tag + webhook mapping Tue, Priya saves signed doc and confirms the final copy legal clear by Tue. I'll draft launch post and webinar blurb for review Thu.
Priya (Legal): All clear on legal side. Copy of signed permission saved to legal drive. Note for records: include "Quoted with permission; embargoed until 2026-05-20" on the case page.
Tom (Marketing): Thanks team. Quick note for PR: our agency will propose a joint press snippet to coordinate with BlueCedar's announcement. Leah please loop PR once we have speaker bio and final quote.
Leah (AE): Will do. Amanda said she prefers our team to handle the first-draft of the webinar description. I'll collect details and drop them here.
Tom (Marketing): Perfect. Closing — will post final quote + screenshot of signed doc here once assets are live. :tada:"
